title: Stability native and BYO image configuration
qualification: Two actual signed normal PWA builds and matching real PIN-vault configuration captures. Functional evidence uses an owned documented Stability HTTPS protocol stand-in with independent TLS/network/PNG proof; it is not a live Stability account, CORS deployment, billing, or hosted generation result. No application backend, extension or host CLI was used.
